title: Likely, Certain, Doubtful
goal: Choose the mood after expressions such as es probable que, es evidente que and no es seguro que.
grammar: Impersonal expressions of probability and certainty

items: I can use es probable que and no es seguro que with the subjunctive, and es evidente que with the indicative.
I can use the present perfect subjunctive after these expressions for things that already happened.
I can use the new words for weighing possibilities.
